meaning:
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.11.23;
son of: Eliada (H0450H)
§ Rezon = "prince"
son of Eliadah, a Syrian, who lead a band of freebooters and established a petty kingdom at Damascus in the time of David and Solomon

elsewhere.note: God raised up an adversary to him, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah.
